plain_statement.zh: 给定中心和方向的误差预算，把基准姿态的严格击中推广到整个姿态单元。
plain_statement.en: Transfer a strict hit from a reference pose to a cell with bounded center and orientation errors.

brief.zh: 拆开方向变化与中心变化，在两个局部坐标分别用三角不等式。误差余量可用于数值生成的覆盖证书。
brief.en: Separate orientation and position errors and bound both local coordinates by the triangle inequality.
